title: Great Pyramid as a device for balancing Earth's energy
summary: Matt tells of Great Pyramid as a device for balancing Earth's energy, about ancient Egypt at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I actually believe that part of the function of the Great Pyramid of Giza and other structures um was a balancing the energy

related.note: Both tellings credit Christopher Dunn with an energy function for the Great Pyramid, but this one says it balanced the Earth's energy where the story says it was a power plant generating energy.

plain: On a show hosted by a podcaster named Jesse Michels, a researcher called Matt says he believes part of the purpose of the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt, and other ancient buildings, was to balance the Earth's energy. He points to the engineer Christopher Dunn, who has argued the pyramid was a kind of machine, which would make it far more than a tomb.
